scope: Independent raw read-only verification of exact saved current top-signal population; not a tradable prediction proof
query: SELECT id,cohort_key,signal_id,observed_at,opened_epoch,opened_at,target_epoch,target_at,closed_epoch,closed_at,instrument,direction,side,horizon_sec,horizon_label,family,lane_id,input_timeframe,policy_state,signal_eligible,validated,direction_conflict,blocked_by_json,confidence,projected_net_pips,projected_net_pips_per_hour,gross_to_spread,entry_bid,entry_ask,entry_mid,entry_spread_pips,exit_bid,exit_ask,exit_mid,gross_pips,net_pips,win,best_net_pips,worst_net_pips,time_to_positive_sec,status,measurement_version,direction_source,outcome_quote_epoch,outcome_quote_at,target_quote_distance_sec,maturity_valid,maturity_reason,source_signal_id,signal_lineage_contract_id,direction_conflict_contract_id FROM positions WHERE status='matured' AND measurement_version=? AND maturity_valid=1 LIMIT 20001
query_plan: SEARCH positions USING INDEX position_factor_episode_order (status=? AND measurement_version=? AND maturity_valid=?)
shm_caveat: Read-only SQLite may use SHM read marks; no byte-identity assertion for SHM. No production SQL writes executed.
missing_availability_fields: No original forecast issue/committed availability, successor consumer observation, entry/exit local receipt, or per-quote tradeable status is retained in this ledger; observed_at is signal snapshot updated_at/generated_utc, not actual observation/commit.
population_caveats: One chosen horizon candidate while previous horizon position remains open; selected diagnostic rows, not all model forecasts.
Horizon rows/pairs and reused signals are correlated; independent N and valid inference intervals unavailable.
A v5 lineage and maturity_valid=1 label verifies only the implemented filters, not original publication timing or execution feasibility.
Majority direction and equal-row bps scores are descriptive of these same observed rows, not pre-registered deployable baselines.
